dct_description_sm: These images are called true-color or natural color because this combination of wavelengths is similar to what the human eye would see. The images are natural-looking images of land surface, oceanic and atmospheric features.

This Corrected Reflectance (True Color) layer is from the Hyper-Angular Rainbow Polarimeter #2 (HARP2) instrument, which is a wide-angle imaging polarimeter aboard NASA's Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, ocean Ecosystem (PACE) satellite. The sensor resolution is 2.6 km, imagery resolution is 1 km, and the temporal resolution is daily.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2025-08-21 and updated as new data arrive. Made from PACE HARP2 Level-1C Science Data, version 3 (PACE_HARP2_L1C_SCI, version 3, doi:10.5067/PACE/HARP2/L1C/SCI/3).
